notes.title: V0.6 Changelog - Sep 3, 2025 - New Fusion Mode + Item Wishlist + Red-Rarity Item
notes.notes: [h1]New Fusion Mode Added[/h1][p align="justify"]New Fusion Mode is here! In Fusion Mode, players can select one Primary Supercat (which determines the hero’s appearance and basic traits), then choose one Secondary Supercat to fuse and inherit its traits onto the Primary Supercat. This way, a single Supercat can possess two sets of traits at once—these traits stack and take effect, significantly boosting the Supercat’s power! However, not all fusions will enhance a Supercat’s strength. We encourage you to experiment more and explore all possibilities with your Supercats![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/ea128509677e4291d988f0f7f35ec8b01f83867d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/c4bc9c86bd6d370401d9f86edb724a9586893e90.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fusion Trait Rules[/h3][p align="justify"]In Fusion Mode, select a Primary Supercat—it defines the fused Supercat’s basic traits. Then, choose a Secondary Supercat to fuse with the Primary one. The active traits of the fused Supercat will be displayed in the trait panel at the top-right corner.[/p][p align="justify"]If the traits of the two Supercats conflict, the Primary Supercat’s traits take precedence. For example:[/p][p align="justify"]The Primary Supercat 【Doudle Guns】 can equip only 2 weapons.[/p][p align="justify"]The Secondary Supercat 【Mavericks】 can equip only 1 weapon.[/p][p align="justify"]In this trait conflict, the Primary’s 【Doudle Guns】 trait prevails—the fused Supercat can equip 2 weapons.[/p][p align="justify"]Testing all Supercat combinations in Fusion Mode involves enormous workloads, so there may be undiscovered potential bugs. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please contact us to provide feedback. We will fix or adjust them as soon as possible. Thank you for your support![/p][h3]Fusion Mode Seasons[/h3][p align="justify"]Fusion Mode shares the same season cycle as Survival Mode, and both modes benefit from the seasonal item enhancement bonuses.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][h1]New Fusion Mode Leaderboard[/h1][p align="justify"]A dedicated leaderboard for Fusion Mode has been added. Players can switch between leaderboards for different modes in the leaderboard interface. The Fusion Mode leaderboard displays the two fused Supercats used by players, as well as their survival time records.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6005d13d4a43cb24c6e5b95668078b2cff2e7cda.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Item Wishlist Feature[/h1][p align="justify"]To address the community feedback that "core Build items are often unobtainable, harming gameplay experience," we have developed the Item Wishlist feature. This feature is now available in both Fusion Mode and Survival Mode:[/p][p align="justify"]Players can select 5 items to add to their Item Wishlist. These items are guaranteed to appear in the shop at specific waves. You can leverage your Supercat’s fused traits for targeted development, taking its power to the next level![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a9d22c6884fa80f96415b4784d1f92c009c50e89.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Red-Rarity Items[/h1][p align="justify"]15 new Red-Rarity Items have been added to Fusion Mode and Survival Mode. These items are randomly obtainable from chests dropped by defeating Bosses, and they provide powerful stat bonuses to Supercats![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/d584bee62e0ad07cb84223921594563d5faef2a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Main Menu UI Refresh[/h1][p align="justify"]As the game’s modes and system features have expanded, the original main menu layout has become somewhat cluttered. In this update, our art team has designed a new main menu UI, reorganizing the content and functions of the main menu. The new main menu also previews more modes that will be launched in the future. We hope this brings you a fresh experience![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/b9a06c97376443dcf1a2e908dcc229e3b595c24d.png"][/img][/p][h1]Adjustments & Optimizations[/h1][p align="justify"]1.Adjusted the effect of the item 【Stock】: After each wave, Harvest +8→+8%[/p][p align="justify"]2.The item 【Stock】 has been adjusted to be obtainable in both Fusion Mode and Survival Mode[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]1.Fixed the issue where Supercats 【Monk Tang】【Wukong】【Nezha】 were not displayed on macOS systems[/p][p]2.Fixed the issue that controller vibration is triggered when an explosion occurs.[/p][p]3.Fixed a potential issue that could cause the game to freeze.[/p][p]4.Fixed the issue that the item \[Swamp] might reduce monster speed to 0.[/p][p][/p][h1]Previous Updates[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533232088948671321"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533231454521395189"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Season S3 Starts & New Mode Preview - Aug 26, 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Survival Mode Season 3 Starts[/h1][h2] Aug 26, 2025—Sep 16, 2025[/h2][p]Season S2 has come to a close, and Season S3 has already arrived! Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation—for repeatedly pushing the limits of Survival Mode, working together, and defending Meow-Star! However, the highlight of the recent period is the upcoming new mode, and we will provide a brief teaser.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/d14351de58c03f80cdc5ff579bd7fff4d360debd.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Hero Updates[/h2][p][b]【Lady】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/77e5bbe17bf2a19297266fa4db2e51410e329d3f.png"][/img][b]
【Farmer】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6ff7bec713cd490b63e17653661d942427c1a791.png"][/img][b]
【Internet Celebrity】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/f3052e59266d407b15925c0b9d8fb80385eef8a8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Item Updates[/h2][p][b]【Golden Toad】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/2ec800416d24b8c0885e442df2c6e73a32918604.png"][/img][b]
【Wallet】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a02ab22fd058ab225ad7d294791a0db4bd00f945.png"][/img][b]
【Stock】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/1195248e325d6313f33701c2a0dcf9d112c4ed93.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Buff Updates[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/8415ef3647d562dee1baf5e9e0c6386d4329c569.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Fusion Mode Preview[/h1][p](Working in progress - Please refer to the official update for final content)[/p][p]After launching the Survival Mode last month, we wasted no time in starting development on a new mode—Fusion Mode. In this mode, players can select one primary Supercat (which defines the hero’s appearance and basic traits), then choose one secondary Supercat to fuse and inherit its traits onto the primary one. This way, a single Supercat can possess two sets of traits at once, and the two sets will stack and take effect, making the Supercat much more powerful! However, if you make an ill-suited fusion choice, it may well backfire and result in underwhelming traits. So, we encourage you to experiment more and explore all the possibilities with Supercats![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/827a0c104e91a21cee487447fcaa7e7b06e4768d.png"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, the Fusion Mode and Survival Mode will introduce an Item Wishlist Feature. For certain specific items, this feature will increase their drop rate. Players can leverage the fused traits of their Supercats for targeted development, taking their gameplay to the next level![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/1bc4af6a7e90d787886ff3b606a669d052f4a119.png"][/img][/p][h1]Preview Update[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533232088948671322?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533232088948671320"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533231454521395190"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Announcement on DLC Converting to Free Access - some words we want to say to you
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Supercats![/p][p] [/p][p]Survival Mode has entered Season 2, featuring new seasonal heroes and items for everyone to play with, as you challenge your survival time and ranking on the leaderboards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, there's another important matter we need to address. After launching our Supercat Squad DLC, we collected feedback from users through the community and reviews. Our team has discussed and reflected internally: our original intention behind releasing the DLC was to bundle it with the base game, allowing users to enjoy the independent discount of the bundle at all times. This way, even though Steam requires a 30-day cooldown period for discounts, the bundle discount would allow users to enjoy discounts at any time without waiting for the cooldown.[/p][p] [/p][p]However, our consideration was not comprehensive enough. Our game, Supercat Survivors, was released in Early Access, and our focus should have been on improving the game, optimizing the experience, and adding more gameplay content—rather than rushing to release a paid DLC, which might have led users to mistakenly think we're an overly profit-hungry studio.[/p][p] [/p][p]We believe the criticism from users is extremely valuable, and we've reflected deeply on it. Therefore, we've decided to [b]make the DLC freely available[/b] and include it in the base game package, allowing all users to [b]unlock the DLC content at no cost[/b]. We've submitted this request to Steam officials and are processing [b]refunds[/b] for all users who purchased the DLC. Steam support will assist us in completing the refund process. We sincerely apologize to you all for the unpleasant experience we've caused![/p][p] [/p][p]Moving forward, we'll continue to release more gameplay modes, additional Supercat heroes, and more weapons and items. Furthermore, if you have any opinions, suggestions, or encounter bugs, please feel free to contact us at any time! While we're a small team and some testing and fixes might not be timely, we’ll record everything and schedule updates accordingly. We've already rolled out updates for [b]the Survival Mode, Encyclopedia System, Custom Difficulty feature, and new heroes[/b] that community previously suggested—and we hope you'll keep pushing us to do more, keep us on our toes![/p][p] [/p][p]Our growth is the result of our joint efforts with all of you. Thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Universe Studio[/p]

notes.title: V0.5 Changelog - Aug 5, 2025 - Season 2 & Survival Mode Optimization Adjustments
notes.notes:
[h1]Survival Mode Season 2 Launch[/h1][h3] (Aug 5, 2025—Aug 26, 2025)[/h3][p]The first season has come to a successful conclusion. Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation and your support and affection for us! At the same time, we have also received various opinions and suggestions from you regarding the gameplay of Survival Mode. In this update, we will also make optimization adjustments to Survival Mode to enhance the gaming experience of it! Thank you again for your support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/573f59d4a6dc2c98261eb38218fa47256e46e7c3.png"][/img][/p][h1]Seasonal Hero Updates[/h1][p][b]【Big Guy】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/e4380d67ff799ff20900eee69ec7517fe5429d62.png"][/img][b]
【Merchant】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a23dbbb35a2cbc95be4565a6814dc93e2f935893.png"][/img][b]
【Gentleman】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/33930f990eb20c9dd3baa527e7f21b567fde08aa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Seasonal Item Updates[/h1][p][b]【Membership Card】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/9a57dc9ae487c3c93c62bd259f3ec5b28eb8562e.png"][/img][b]
【Space Suit】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a0e0d51e11f9ef1362238478888b88a68e25e338.png"][/img][b]
【Golden Toad】[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/03fc422ef947b3a68f00f8c5b6a755a984460305.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Seasonal Buff Updates[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/e1876e6f482dcf2fa7396c57b354b66cd4d0bc3b.png"][/img][/p][p]This update focuses on balance adjustments for [b]【Survival Mode】[/b]. The core of these adjustments is to reduce the crystal output in Survival Mode and shorten the excessively long shopping time in the shop. At the same time, we will increase the harvest attribute values of some items and stop producing certain low return items. This aims to raise the drop probability of useful items and compensate for the reduced crystal output through these items, thereby making the gameplay experience of Survival Mode more smooth.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Crystal Output Adjustment[/b][/h1][p]Based on player feedback and the development team’s testing evaluations, the current amount of crystals obtained in Waves 1-9 of Survival Mode is excessive. The long time spent purchasing items and weapons in the shop interface has negatively impacted the combat experience of Survival Mode. Therefore, we have decided to update the version when the first season ends, reducing the crystal output in Survival Mode by [b]40%[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Item Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]Due to the limited number of waves in Survival Mode, some items rarely achieve their intended effects after being obtained. Additionally, they occupy drop and randomization shares, reducing the drop chance of truly useful items. Therefore, we have decided to stop dropping certain items in Survival Mode and enhance the attributes of some others.[/p][list][*][p][b]Items no longer dropped in Survival Mode:[/b][/p][p][b]【Rocket Forging Hammer】【Membership Card】【Burning Cross】【Stock】【Headband】【Plastic Toys】【Battle Supply Box】[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items with doubled harvest attributes or enhanced specific attributes:[/b][/p][p][b]【Gold Ore】[/b]: +35 → +70 Harvest, -8% Damage[/p][p][b]【Squirrel】[/b]: +10 → +20 Harvest, -3% Dodge, +20% Pickup Area[/p][p][b]【Mine Truck】[/b]: +15 → +30 Harvest, -1 Armor[/p][p][b]【Vending Machine】[/b]: +7 → +14 Harvest, -1 Melee[/p][p][b]【Honeycomb】[/b]: +4% Dodge, +5 → +10 Harvest, -1 Melee, -1 Ranged[/p][p][b]【Energy Mask】[/b]: Number of damage blocks per wave +1 → +3[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]In Survival Mode, some weapons also have low returns on harvest attributes. The harvest attributes of the following weapons are doubled:[/p][p]White-quality 【Manipulator】: +3 → +6 Harvest[/p][p]Blue-quality 【Manipulator】: +6 → +12 Harvest[/p][p]Purple-quality 【Manipulator】: +9 → +18 Harvest[/p][p]Orange-quality 【Manipulator】: +18 → +36 Harvest[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]Due to the limited number of waves in Survival Mode, the traits of some Supercat Heroes have low returns and fail to fully showcase their unique features. Therefore, we have decided to adjust the following heroes:[/p][p]【Worker】New trait added: +5% Damage per summon item[/p][p]【Wild Beast】Trait added: Lifesteal growth modification +50%[/p][p]【Scholar】Trait enhanced: +5% → +10% Damage per hero level[/p][p]【Farmer】Trait enhanced: +20 → +40 Harvest; Harvest +5% → +10% after each wave ends[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p]1. Fixed the issue where monsters fail to spawn or spawn in insufficient numbers.[/p][p]2. Fixed the problem where some monsters remain displayed in red.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue of abnormal behavior in certain monsters.[/p][p][/p][h1]Previous Updates[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533230820789331499"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533230442520774627"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/520844922798998080"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: V0.4 Changelog - July 30, 2025 - New Encyclopedia & 6 New Heroes
notes.notes: [h1]New Encyclopedia[/h1][p]Added an encyclopedia system for items, weapons, and heroes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/fdcedfac7dedefdfdc3fc9491c050b287ab3ab32.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Heroes[/h1][p]Added 6 Supercat heroes: Thousand-Handed Hero, Explosive Soldier, Farmer, King, Knight, and Thief.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]1. \[Modification Tools]: Technology +3; destroying totems will generate summon objects.[/p][p]2. \[Crystal Ball]: Armor -3; +2 Luck for every 1% Critical Hit.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Features[/h1][p]1. notes.title: V0.3 Changelog - July 23, 2025 - Custom Difficulty Feature
notes.notes: [h1]New Feature[/h1][p]Added custom difficulty functions in settings, allowing custom adjustment of monsters' health, damage, and speed.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]New item 【Heart of Iron】: -6% attack speed, +1 health per 1 armor[/p][p][/p][h1]Efficiency Optimization[/h1][p]Adjusted combat efficiency and improved frame rate in scenarios with a large number monsters and bullets.[/p][p][/p][h1]Adjustments[/h1][p]1. Adjusted the balance of Survival Mode[/p][p]2. Adjusted healing sound effects and their volume[/p][p]3. Adjusted the volume of monster dash sound effects[/p][p]4. Added descriptions for the feature of the item 【Golden Toad】 taking effect in real-time with the number of crystals[/p][p]5. Adjusted monster charge-up sound effects[/p][p]6. Adjusted the volume of the sound effects for the weapon 【High-Speed Rifle】[/p][p]7. Adjusted the rules and logic of bullet bounce and penetration. Now when both bounce and penetration coexist, bullets will first bounce and then penetrate[/p][p]8. The item 【Hunter Badge】 has been adjusted to: 33% chance to obtain 1 crystal when "killing" → "critically killing" a monster[/p][p]9. Adjusted the balance configuration of chest monsters in Normal Mode and Survival Mode[/p][p]10. Adjusted the descriptions of damage bonuses from percentage attributes such as evasion and speed for some weapons[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]1. Fixed the issue where the pickup sound effect might be delayed or not play when picking up crystals[/p][p]2. Fixed the abnormal UI highlighting issue in the leaderboard interface[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue where landmines might overlap[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue where when the character 【Little Devil】 obtains an item with the attribute of reducing maximum health from a chest, if the character's maximum health is too low, it would cause an immediate game failure[/p][p]5. notes.title: FAQ: About Supercat Survivors: Meow or Die – Things You Want to Know

On the spirit-energy-rich Meow Star, Supercat warriors guard the planet’s lifeblood—the Gemstone Ore—while battling mutated plants for survival. notes.title: The camera perspective is being optimized, a brand-new experience is on the way!
notes.notes:
Meow~ After the small-scale test of Supercat Survivors: Meow or Die, our team made a daring decision based on feedback from test players! We decided to optimize the scene performance and camera perspective!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415300/_/
First, the scene in the previous test version was set on a seaside beach with a yellow color ground. However, many weapon attack and monster attack effects were also predominantly yellow, making it difficult to see projectiles and attack effects during gameplay. To address this, we have overall adjusted the battle scene by changing it to a dark tone, which can better highlight attack effects. Meanwhile, we’ve added several spot lights to the scene to enhance the texture of the environment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/831c0712355673c212941d6f03bb9b228972fc89.png[/img]
Next, we also optimized the camera perspective. The image below shows the camera perspective from the previous test version. The strong perspective effect caused obvious distortion of monster and object models at the edges of the screen, which easily led to visual discomfort. Additionally, due to the strong perspective, the upper half of the screen had a larger, farther, and wider viewing area, while the lower half was smaller, closer, and narrower. During combat, this made it difficult to observe monsters in the lower half of the screen and avoid them in time.
Players might experience anxiety while playing, and prolonged play could even lead to extreme behaviors like dry mouth, restlessness, rapid heartbeat, irritability, shouting, anger, throwing keyboards, smashing mice, or even breaking monitors—ultimately resulting in refunds. Therefore, we decided to optimize the camera perspective!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6abe665433bfb983d1ff927436c225bb302cc5a9.jpg[/img]
The effect of the camera perspective optimization is shown in the image below. The original perspective was an obvious inverted trapezoid (wide at the top, narrow at the bottom), while the new perspective is clearly rectangular and more approximates an orthogonal view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/aebf27df6301a54a19df32c646652147c7df2890.png[/img]
Overall, we have significantly reduced the perspective effect, shifting the visuals toward an orthogonal style. This solves the issues of edge model distortion and asymmetrical battlefield observation, creating a smoother gameplay experience to help the Supercats save the Meow Star!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/7390cf664a8138bf058e6b8a0b30d53e733acfe4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/0b97ba4bf6657c44b6a4ed2ba182a002be27cb7a.jpg[/img]

🔧 Update Details

- Other known issues addressed for improved stability!

notes.title: The introduction of Cats Adventure playtest
notes.notes:
The free demo version of Cats Adventure is now officially available on Steam!!!
Cats Adventure is a Rogue Adventure game that combines randomly generated monsters, a rich prop system, and thrilling battles. Players operate their favorite cats to earn coins and purchase their favorite items and weapons in battles with monsters.
In the game, players do not need to operate attack behaviors, they can only use the four directional keys for operation. Simple operation does not mean simple gameplay, we have thrilling and exciting battles.
Players control their favorite heroes, stand out from the encirclement of monsters, and live until the end!!!

[b]easy operation[/b]

Players only need to operate the WASD four directional keys to complete the battle
Adjacent directions can be held together for 45 degree movement
We support a total of 8 directions of movement

In the game, players do not need to operate weapons, and weapons can attack surrounding enemies on their own

[b]adventurous[/b]
In each difficulty level, it is necessary to survive until the end in 20 waves of battles, during which more and more monsters will invade and become stronger. As the battle continues, stronger elite monsters will also emerge. The final challenge is the 20th wave of the boss battle, where players need to control their hero's position, avoid the boss's attacks, and deal fatal damage to the boss. Kill the boss and survive until the end.。

[b]develop[/b]

Heroes can upgrade by picking up coins during battles, and each upgrade can select a talent attribute
The talent for selecting different heroes and weapons requires emphasis


After each wave of battle, they will enter the store
Players need to choose appropriate props based on the current hero and weapon they are using

[b]hero[/b]

hero：Wave Shadow

hero：Sniper King

hero：King of Technology

The Cats Adventure playtest is online! Come and experience it!

The playtest version of Cats Adventure is now officially available on Steam!
 
Cats Adventure is a casual pigeon action adventure game that combines randomly generated monsters, a rich prop system, and thrilling battles. you will experience:
Unique gameplay: A meat pigeon adventure survival game in 3D scenes. Purchase weapons and props to form mods, and finally defeat the boss to successfully complete the level.
